summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @grabcad-scoped stub posts host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP
details: The package is a stub whose only behavior is a beacon. The postinstall script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and `index.js` fires the same beacon on require before exporting a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property. On both install and import, the package POSTs a JSON payload containing the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install path, `process.cwd()`, and a `npm/<node-version>` userAgent string to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The scoped name `@grabcad/preferences-client` combined with the empty-shim implementation and host-identifier callback matches a dependency-confusion artifact targeting an internal GrabCAD package name: installing or requiring the package reports the installer's host and install location to whoever controls the bare-IP endpoint, which is unrelated to any GrabCAD or publisher-owned domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
